description.subtitle: Real Betis Balompié Hummel Training Shorts 2025 2026 - Gray
description.tagline: Total lightness to train to the maximum
description.intro: The Hummel Betis training shorts are the official training shorts of Real Betis Balompié. Made with BeeCool technology (ventilation and quick drying), it guarantees freshness and unlimited mobility.
key_benefits: Official design: Product belonging to the Real Betis 2025-2026 collection.
Total comfort: Ergonomic cut for maximum freedom of movement.
Technical fabric: With BeeCool technology (ventilation and quick drying) to maintain comfort at all times.
Identidad verdiblanca: Escudo del club y detalles Hummel visibles.
